name: ComfyUI_MiniMaxH3_Director
description: ComfyUI_MiniMaxH3_Director is a ComfyUI workflow that acts as a director for the MiniMax H3 model, wiring the model into node-based pipelines for structured generation. It is part of the fast-moving ComfyUI ecosystem around the MiniMax H3 family, giving creators a reusable 'director' pattern for steering outputs within their existing ComfyUI setups.
highlights: Reusable 'director' workflow for MiniMax H3 in ComfyUI
Node-based pipeline integration for structured generation
Apache-2.0 licensed from the active H3 community
460 stars in days show rapid ComfyUI ecosystem adoption
curatorNote: The ComfyUI community moves fast, and the MiniMax H3 director pattern is a great example of how model releases turn into reusable creative tooling within days.
